nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How often must air exchange and ventilation occur between toilets according to the standards?
nodes.answer: Air exchange and ventilation must occur at least 5 times per hour.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Sanitation infrastructure|Flush toilets_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What operational challenges do traditional flush toilets face?
nodes.answer: Traditional flush toilets often face operational challenges and environmental pollution risks due to maintenance neglect.
